description: This file defines a mock class 'ControlServerInternalFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IControlServerInternalFactory' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods for creating control and control server internal objects within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: ControlServerInternalFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock class for the IControlServerInternalFactory interface, used for unit testing control server internal factory creation methods.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Mock method to create a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: createControlServerInternal
methods.description: Mock method to create a shared pointer to an IControlServerInternal instance, given an ID and a client internal.
